sloka: इत्येवं चिन्तयित्वा तु हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः।भूयः संस्तम्भयामास वानराणां महाचमूम् ।। ६.६७.८२ ।।
transliteration: ityevaṁ cintayitvā tu hanumān mārutātmajaḥ।bhūyaḥ saṁstambhayāmāsa vānarāṇāṁ mahācamūm ।। 6.67.82 ।।

translations.english: "Therefore, I will see the exhibition of his prowess for a while. Thereafter I shall reinforce the scattered army of Vanaras."
